insights.summary: PreSense routing and context help agents close more calls from digital shoppers.
insights.quote: They like walking in with the pages the caller looked at, especially on purchase calls where the borrower has been on three or four lender sites.

insights.summary: Regulated customers want configurable redaction of identifiers in transcripts and summaries, with role-based access and audit.
insights.quote: An audit log of who viewed a transcript. That's the piece that makes the rest of it defensible in an exam.
